headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 26, 2026, the portfolio is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.16% compared to SPY's 13.01%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolio is effectively navigating the current market environment, showcasing resilience during potential periods of macro uncertainty. The average alpha of 11.15% further emphasizes that the portfolio is not only generating strong returns but is also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved an impressive return of 45.00%, significantly contributing to the overall portfolio strength. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.99%, highlighting the variability within the portfolio set. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
